newsitem.title: USA: Neopath starts new trials on AutoPap System.
newsitem.headline: Neopath starts new trials on AutoPap System.

text.p: NeoPath Inc said on Thursday it has started additional clinical trials on its AutoPap System to study its safety and effectiveness as a primary screener of Pap smear slides.
AutoPap now is used to review slides that have been deemed "normal" by human screeners or cytotechnologists.

In June, NeoPath submitted a pre-market approval application to market the device as a primary screener of Pap smear slides. Recently, it received confirmation from the Center for Devices and Radiological Health of the FDA that the application must include a new prospective clinical study.

"We are working closely with FDA officials to meet their requirements for (more) information about the effectiveness of the AutoPap System as a primary screener for Pap smears," Alan Nelson, chief executive officer, said in a statement.

NeoPath intends to submit the results of these clinical trials to the FDA to help establish a new protocol for studying the safety and effectiveness of the AutoPap System, the company said in a statement.
